en.comment: at some point, this file should become empty and unnecessary.

event_deaths.one: This past moon, m_c has taken {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} place in SunColony. c_n mourns their loss, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Colonymates will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
event_deaths.many: The past moon, %{insert} have taken their place in SunColony. c_n mourns their loss, and their Colonymates will miss where they had been in their lives. Moments of their lives are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to them take them to their final resting place.

event_shaken_grief.one: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the ants of c_n. %{insert} is particularly shaken by it.
event_shaken_grief.many: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the ants of c_n. %{insert} are particularly shaken by it.

en.condition_retire_adolescent: m_c decides {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'d rather spend {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} time helping around the Colony and entertaining the antlings; {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} warmly welcomed into the elders' den.
en.condition_retire_adolescent_ceremony: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} given the name %{newname} in honor of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} contributions to %{clan}Colony.
en.condition_retire_no_leader: m_c has decided to retire from normal Colony duty.
en.condition_retire_normal: Seeing m_c struggling the last few moons, lead_name approaches {PRONOUN/m_c/object} and promises that no one would think less of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} for retiring early, and that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would still be a valuable member of the Colony as an elder. m_c agrees; later that day, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} elder ceremony is held.
en.ceremony_leader_bloodthirsty: %{oldname} has become the new monarch. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/stare/stares} down at {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} Colonymates with readied mandables, promising a new era for the Colonies.
en.ceremony_leader_1: %{oldname} has been promoted to the new monarch of the Colony. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/travel/travels} to the Moonstone immediately to get {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} nine lives and {VERB/lead_name/are/is} hailed by {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} new name, lead_name.
en.ceremony_leader_2: %{oldname} has become the new monarch of the Colony. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/vow/vows} to protect the Colony, even at the cost of {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} nine lives.
en.ceremony_leader_3: %{oldname} has received {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nine lives and has become the new monarch of the Colony. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/feel/feels} like {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is}n't ready for this new responsibility, but will try {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} best to do what is right for the Colony.
en.ceremony_closer: Visit lead_name's profile to see {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} full monarch ceremony.
en.ceremony_deputy_bloodthirsty: m_c has been chosen as the new heir. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/look/looks} at the Colony monarch with an odd glint in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes.
en.ceremony_deputy: lead_name chooses m_c to take over as the heir. %{previous}
en.ceremony_deputy_prev2: {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/don't/doesn't} know if dep_name would approve, but life must go on.
en.ceremony_deputy_nolead_nodep: Without a monarch or heir, the Colony has been directionless. They all turn to m_c with hope for the future.
en.ceremony_deputy_nolead_retireddep: The Colony is without a monarch, but a new heir must still be named. m_c is chosen as the new heir. The retired heir nods {PRONOUN/dep_name/poss} approval.
en.ceremony_deputy_lead_retireddep0: m_c has been chosen as the new heir. The Colony chitters {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} name in approval.
en.ceremony_deputy_lead_retireddep1: m_c has been chosen as the new heir. Some of the older Colony members question the wisdom of this choice.
en.ceremony_deputy_lead_retireddep2: m_c has been chosen as the new heir. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/hold/holds} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head up high and {VERB/m_c/promise/promises} to do {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} best for the Colony.
en.ceremony_deputy_lead_retireddep3: lead_name has been thinking deeply all day about who {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject} would trust and respect enough to stand at {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} side. At sunhigh, {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject} {VERB/lead_name/make/makes} the announcement that m_c will be the Colony's new heir.
en.ceremony_deputy_lead_retireddep4: m_c has been chosen as the new heir. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/pray/prays} to SunColony that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} the right choice for the Colony.
en.ceremony_deputy_lead_retireddep5: m_c has been chosen as the new heir. Although {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} nervous, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/put/puts} on a brave face and {VERB/m_c/look/looks} forward to serving the Colony.
en.ceremony_deputy_unsuitable: No ant is truly fit to be heir, but the position can't remain vacant. m_c is appointed as the new heir.
en.ceremony_deputy_none: There are no ants fit to become heir.

en.event_mediator_app: m_c has chosen to use {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} skills and experience to help solve the Colony's disagreements. A meeting is called, and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/become/becomes} the Colony's newest diplomat.

en.event_lost1: After a long journey, m_c has finally returned home to c_n.
en.event_lost2: m_c was found at the border, tired but happy to be home.
en.event_lost3: m_c strides into the Colony, much to the everyone's surprise. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} home!
en.event_lost4: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} met so many friends on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} journey, but c_n is where m_c truly belongs. With a tearful goodbye, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/return/returns} home.
